description: Pomona hydroponic tower — first monitoring dashboard (card #222). Data: MQTT pomona/# ingested by the pomona-ingest Telegraf bridge into the InfluxDB pomona bucket (tags zone/metric, field value); pump watts come from the homeassistant bucket (HA InfluxDB export).

panels.title: Unit
panels.description: pomona/unit/status (retained): online/offline as published by the firmware's MQTT LWT.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona_meta" and r.metric == "status" and r._field == "value") |> last() |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Unit"})

from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona_meta" and r.metric == "fw_version" and r._field == "value") |> last() |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Firmware"})

from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "unit" and r.metric == "rssi_dbm" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "RSSI"})

from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "unit" and r.metric == "uptime_s" and r._field == "value") |> last() |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Uptime"})

panels.title: Reservoir
panels.description: pomona/water/level_points (0-4 probe points wet). >=3 OK, 1-2 top up soon, 0 CRIT — pump dry-run risk.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "water" and r.metric == "level_points" and r._field == "value") |> last() |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Level"})

panels.title: EC (mS/cm)
panels.description: K=0.9745 probe. Shaded bands: 0.8-1.0 mS/cm (amber) = current TRANSPLANT target; 1.4-1.6 mS/cm (green) = established-plant target (plan v4). Steer dosing toward the band that matches the crop stage.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "water" and r.metric == "ec_ms_cm" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "EC (mS/cm)"})

panels.title: pH
panels.description: Calibrated 2-point (7.00 / 4.00), validated at 10.01. Shaded band 5.8-6.2 = hydroponic target. Raw electrode voltage is on pomona/water/ph_raw_v if the calibration drifts.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "water" and r.metric == "ph" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "pH"})

panels.title: Water temperature
panels.description: Reservoir water temperature (DS18B20). Hydroponic comfort zone roughly 18-24 °C.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "water" and r.metric == "temp_c" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Water °C"})

panels.title: Reservoir level
panels.description: pomona/water/level_points over time. >=3 OK (green), 1-2 top up soon (amber), 0 CRIT dry (red).

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "water" and r.metric == "level_points" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Level"})

panels.title: Canopy light (lux)
panels.description: BH1750, mounted BELOW the canopy: reads ~1/60 of true canopy lux. Use as the day/night RHYTHM indicator (photoperiod), not absolute light level.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "air" and r.metric == "lux" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Lux (sensor)"})

panels.title: Air — temperature & humidity
panels.description: BME280 @0x77. Humidity on the right axis.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "air" and r.metric == "temp_c" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Air °C"})

from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "air" and r.metric == "humidity_pct" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Humidity %"})

panels.title: Air pressure
panels.description: BME280 barometric pressure — weather trend context.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "air" and r.metric == "pressure_hpa" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Pressure hPa"})

panels.title: Pump power (HA)
panels.description: sensor.pomona_pump_electric_consumption_w from the homeassistant bucket (HA InfluxDB export). Flat non-zero = pump running; the on/off rhythm is the irrigation cycle. Lamp switch state panel is a follow-up (entity id TBD).

targets.query: from(bucket: "homeassistant") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id == "pomona_pump_electric_consumption_w" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Pump W"})
